description: Recent crypto headlines with an impact score and the assets each one touches. Impact is a keyword heuristic, not a judgement about the market. Pass hours for "today" or "the last 24 hours"; every headline says how old it is.

asset.description: Base symbol, e.g. BTC. Omit for everything.

hours.description: Only headlines published in the last N hours, 1 to 168.

name: news_recent
